summary: A Yes vote enacts a 1% transactions and use (sales) tax in the City of Shafter for city services and facilities.

tax.text: A Yes vote would enact a 1% sales tax to fund police, streets, libraries, recreation, parks, and other city services.
tax.quote: Shall the measure to provide local funding for City of Shafter services and facilities, including police services, traffic enforcement, street repairs and safety improvements, library and recreation services, park maintenance, and other municipal services, by enacting a 1% sales tax generating approximately $4,000,000 annually until ended by voters, with annual audits, public review, and all revenue remaining in the City of Shafter, be adopted?

tax.text: The No position opposes Measure Q's proposed 1% local sales tax to fund city services.
tax.quote: The City Council has approved placing a measure on the November 3, 2026, General Municipal Election ballot asking Shafter voters whether to approve a 1% local transactions and use (sales) tax to fund City services.
